title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-06-24
lineage: Audience master > ?? > Reel(Mono, Scotch 7" reel @ 3&3/4ips) > Alesis Masterlink ML-9600 > CDR > EAC(secure, offset corrected) > Cool Edit Pro > TLH > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Muffled audience recording and a disappointing St. Stephen make this set hard to recommend despite some crowd energy.
ai_review.review: The performance is marred by what many listeners describe as the worst version of St. Stephen they've heard, with the band failing to reach the song's classic “lady‑fingers” section. The audio capture is low‑fidelity and sounds more like an audience tape than a clean soundboard mix, leaving only the crowd’s enthusiasm as a redeeming factor.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are few and contradictory; overall show quality is judged poor (weak St. Stephen) and recording quality is described as sub‑par, leading to a low combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound quality described as not too good; likely an audience mic with muffled clarity and limited fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on overall set pacing or flow were provided.
